summary: Enerflex Ltd., a Calgary-based foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE, furnished a Form 6-K covering October 2026 whose sole substantive exhibit is a Canadian-style Material Change Report; the filed text itself, however, is present only as a base64-encoded PDF wrapper and contains no readable disclosure of a transaction. No stake percentage, per-share price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is stated in the excerpt, so no special-situation characterization can be supported from this filing alone.
